recent_articles.title: Infrastructure is foundation of economic growth, says M. Jamshed - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M. Jamshed**, during a special address at **The Hindu’s Maharashtra Infrastructure Conclave 2026**, highlighted the crucial role of infrastructure in development, emphasizing its importance for India's economic growth. He praised **Maharashtra** as a leading example of infrastructure development from Delhi's perspective and expressed optimism about the state's continued success.  **Mr. Jamshed** noted that the Centre's focus on integrated infrastructure development since 2014 has expanded beyond traditional sectors, encompassing physical, digital, and social infrastructure. He emphasized core sectors like roads, railways, maritime transport, and energy alongside digital and social infrastructure segments such as rural drinking water, sanitation, and water resource management.

recent_articles.title: Rubio's maiden India visit aims to repair strained ties; boost Quad cooperation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio** will visit **India** from May 23 to 26, 2026, aiming to repair strained bilateral ties.  He will meet with **External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar**, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, and attend a Quad Foreign Ministers meeting in New Delhi. The trip follows a recent three-day visit by **India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri** to Washington DC focused on stabilizing the relationship.  The talks are expected to focus on bolstering ties in energy, trade, investment, critical technology, and people-to-people exchanges, as well as discussing the West Asia crisis and its economic impact.

recent_articles.title: India battles power cuts as heatwave boosts electricity demand to record - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** is experiencing power cuts due to record-breaking heat and high electricity demand exceeding 270 gigawatts. **The government** has urged consumers to conserve energy, with outages lasting from 40 minutes to an hour in some areas like Chennai.  **Grid-India**, the national regulator, reported a peak deficit of 2.57 gigawatts late Thursday evening. Experts suggest that India needs to accelerate battery storage development to manage surplus solar energy during nighttime hours.

recent_articles.title: Did China spy on Elon Musk, other tech executives during Trump's Beijing visit? Blogger makes big claim - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Independent blogger and author Jennifer Zeng claims **China** spied on US President Donald Trump's two-day visit to Beijing last week, alleging that disguised military personnel monitored the delegation. Zeng accused a server standing behind billionaire Elon Musk of being a "highly decorated active-duty Chinese military officer" and another waitress of being an "elite battalion commander."  Zeng has previously accused **China** of involvement in the killing of Khalistani terrorist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Canada.

recent_articles.title: Marco Rubio visits India: What’s at stake with Trump-Modi ties strained? | International Trade News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Marco Rubio**, US Secretary of State, is visiting India for a three-day trip ahead of the Quad meeting on May 26th.  Rubio's visit comes amidst strained relations between **Donald Trump** and **Narendra Modi**, as well as efforts to mend ties with **India**. The visit also coincides with the US Department of Justice dropping criminal fraud charges against Indian billionaire **Gautam Adani**, and an extension of a sanctions waiver allowing purchases of Russian oil.  Rubio's trip is seen as part of Washington's effort to strengthen bilateral relations with India, particularly in light of tensions between Trump and Modi last year.

recent_articles.title: Iran’s enriched uranium stockpile: Can it be safely transferred? | US-Israel war on Iran News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** reiterated that the US will not allow Iran to keep its enriched uranium stockpile, while **Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei** issued a directive prohibiting the removal of the uranium from Iranian soil.  The future of the estimated 440kg of highly enriched uranium remains a sticking point in peace negotiations between the US and Iran. While experts say it is possible to transfer enriched uranium safely, concerns remain about its potential for misuse. The **International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)** has specific protocols for transporting enriched uranium hexafluoride, but the issue of transferring this material safely from Iran remains unresolved.

recent_articles.title: Slow-moving bands of heavy rain trigger flooding and landslides in parts of China | China | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Heavy rainfall across southern and central China has led to flash flooding, landslides, and waterlogging. The **Bay of Bengal**, **South China Sea**, and **Pacific Ocean** contributed to the prolonged downpour that caused 12 deaths and forced evacuations.  Meanwhile, extreme heat warnings have been issued for northern India, with temperatures exceeding 40°C (104°F) in several regions. These conditions are expected to persist until Wednesday when thunderstorms may develop.

recent_articles.title: Africa summit in India postponed over Ebola outbreak fears
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **India-Africa Forum Summit**, scheduled for May 28-31 in Delhi, has been postponed due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The **World Health Organization** declared the latest outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, with over 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths reported so far.  The postponement was announced jointly by **India** and the **African Union**, citing the "emerging public health situation in the continent."

recent_articles.title: Twisha Sharma death: Madhya Pradesh government proposes to transfer case to CBI - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Madhya Pradesh** government proposed transferring the dowry death case of Twisha Sharma to the **CBI**. The notification, issued by Home Department Secretary Krishnaveni Desavatu, cites the Delhi Special Police Establishment Act for extending investigative powers to the state.  The case, registered at Katara Hills Police Station, involves allegations of harassment and dowry-related deaths against her husband Samarth Singh and mother-in-law Giribala Singh.

recent_articles.title: What else does U.S. have in store for India’s foreign policy? asks Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** general secretary Jairam Ramesh questioned **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's** future plans for Indian foreign policy, citing Rubio's recent announcements regarding a Venezuelan presidential visit to India and the postponement of the event due to an Ebola outbreak in Africa.  Ramesh expressed concern over **Rubio's** repeated pre-emptive pronouncements on India's foreign policy decisions, including the halt of Operation Sindoor.

recent_articles.title: Voter confusion fears over simultaneous polls ‘misplaced’, says ONOE JPC chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. Chaudhary**, chairman of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on ‘One Nation One Election’, defended the proposal, arguing that Indian voters are politically astute and can differentiate between national and state issues.  He cited examples from Delhi and other states where voters supported different parties in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. **CII**, **ASSOCHAM**, and **GCCI** backed the proposal, while **Gujarat University Vice-Chancellor Dr. Neerja Gupta** highlighted how frequent polls disrupt academic schedules and increase financial costs. The committee also heard concerns from the **Congress**, which argued that simultaneous elections would allow national narratives to overshadow state issues.

recent_articles.title: Fake call centres duping U.S. citizens busted in Bengaluru, man from Delhi, another from U.P. arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka State Cyber Command** officials raided four fake call centers in Bengaluru, uncovering a sophisticated operation that defrauded U.S. citizens by impersonating a prominent American accounting firm. The accused, Prashanth and Akash, allegedly collected millions of rupees from victims through fake tax advice, license renewal services, and counterfeit software keys.  The investigation revealed the use of shell companies to launder money and a network of over 120 employees trained to deceive victims using US accents. **Pronab Mohanty**, Director General of Cyber Command, stated that further investigations will focus on tracing the money trail and identifying bank accounts used in the fraud.

recent_articles.title: Ladakh leaders to meet Home Ministry officials on May 22, Sonam Wangchuk part of delegation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A delegation from Ladakh, including climate activist **Sonam Wangchuk**, is meeting with **Union Home Ministry** officials on Friday to discuss demands for constitutional safeguards such as Statehood and inclusion under the Sixth Schedule of the Constitution. This meeting follows a previous inconclusive high-powered committee meeting in February and comes after the violence in Leh city in September 2025, which stalled talks.  The delegation will reiterate their demands for Statehood, while officials have offered safeguards under Article 371 of the Constitution.

recent_articles.title: Take forward reforms, PM tells Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** convened a full Council of Ministers meeting in New Delhi on Thursday, May 21, 2026. The session focused on the government's reform agenda amidst geopolitical shifts and saw presentations from various ministries including labor, power, commerce, finance, agriculture, railways, and NITI Aayog.  The meetings reviewed past achievements and future plans, outlining targets for each ministry.

recent_articles.title: D.K. Shivakumar challenges BJP leaders to travel by public transport daily - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, Deputy Chief Minister of **Karnataka**, criticized **BJP** leaders for using public transport only for photoshoots in response to the Prime Minister's call for austerity measures. He challenged them to travel by public transport daily, questioning the sincerity of their actions.  He also addressed the Prime Minister's call to abstain from buying gold and expressed his commitment to visit Delhi when called upon by **Rahul Gandhi**, Leader of the Opposition.

recent_articles.title: Iran warns of readiness for war and economic costs as US talks falter | US-Israel war on Iran News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Iran’s** Foreign Minister, **Abbas Araghchi**, warned that the US-led war on Iran is impacting American households through rising inflation and debt costs.  He also stated that a lack of trust with the United States has hindered negotiations.  **Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf**, parliament speaker, mocked the US for funding a "failed TV host" to act as Secretary of War in the Persian Gulf. **Ebrahim Azizi**, head of Iran’s National Security Commission, announced plans to control traffic in the Strait of Hormuz and impose fees on vessels that do not cooperate with Iran.  The Iranian government has called on citizens to take to the streets for nightly demonstrations, while state-run media promotes a call to arms.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders demanded the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the **Union Education Minister**, over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal.  They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: CJI Surya Kant clarifies ‘parasites’ remarks, says youth are pillars of country - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Justice of India (CJI)** Surya Kant issued a statement clarifying that his remarks about "attacks" on institutions were not directed at the youth but at individuals with fake or bogus degrees in professions like law and media. He stated that these individuals act as parasites by attacking institutions without any legitimate standing. **The CJI** maintained that he holds immense respect for India's youth and expressed pride in their potential to contribute to a developed nation.

recent_articles.title: BRICS is evolving with new members; differences will take time to resolve: Brazil FM Mauro Vieira - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BRICS** Foreign Ministers meeting in Delhi concluded with a detailed Chair Statement supporting Indian initiatives and the Palestinian cause, but failed to reach consensus on positions regarding the war in West Asia.  Despite disagreements, **Mauro Vieira**, Brazilian Foreign Minister, emphasized the continued importance of **BRICS**.

recent_articles.title: Adhikari aide killing: CBI conducts searches at multiple locations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The CBI** conducted searches at multiple locations in connection with the murder of West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari's aide Chandrakant Rath. The agency took over the investigation from the **West Bengal Police**, forming a seven-member special investigation team under a DIG of Special Crime from Delhi.  Rath was shot dead on May 6th, two days after the West Bengal Assembly election results were declared. Three individuals have been arrested in connection with the case, while police believe at least eight people were involved.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Youth Congress protests in Delhi, chief Uday Bhanu Chib detained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Indian Youth Congress (IYC)** staged a protest in New Delhi demanding the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** over alleged NEET-UG question paper leaks.  Protesters, including IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib, were detained by police as they marched towards **Pradhan's** residence. The examination was cancelled on May 3rd and a re-test is scheduled for June 21st. The IYC accused the BJP-led government of creating a corrupt system that favors wealthy students while disadvantaging those from poor backgrounds.
